_note: Noticing starters for days when the learner arrives with no question. Everyday, safe, no special kit.

starters.mission: Find a shadow outside or by a window. Mark where its tip is, then look again in an hour.
Put a tiny bit of sugar and a tiny bit of salt near where you've seen ants. Watch from a distance for five minutes — don't disturb them.
Take two ice cubes. Put one on a steel plate and one on a cloth. Which melts first?
Put a few moong or chana seeds on a damp cloth. Check them every morning.
Hang two small wet cloths: one in the sun, one in the shade. Check every 15 minutes.
Spend two minutes looking at something near a window and tell me three things you notice.
Collect five different leaves that have already fallen. How could you sort them?
Gather a few small kitchen things (a spoon, a bottle cap, a leaf, a coin). Which do you think will float in a bowl of water?
